title: Align test-ref refusal status codes and error bodies with the local API
outcome: Test-ref route responses preserve parser HTTP statuses and include a standard error message beside the stable code; internal join failures remain distinct from post-enqueue durability uncertainty.
acceptance: Tests verify malformed/oversized/content-type errors preserve their intended 4xx statuses and standard error field, owner refusals use the agreed authority status, and worker join failure does not assert an enqueue occurred.
Existing unconfirmed-write retry and same-row durability semantics remain intact.
disposal_reason: Superseded by the automatic remote-result design (Greg, Advisor #2639; Fable2 #4079): no operator owner key, REGISTER TEST REF or registration registry.
